translations.web: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.
translations.bsb: If what was stolen is actually found alive in his possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—he must pay back double.
translations.kjv: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
translations.asv: If the theft be found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep, he shall pay double.
